findings.current: Above the grand banquet hall of the imperial palace, strewn with the blood and corpses of the rebel army, the Bow Saint spoke after finally revealing herself.
findings.defect: “Above” places the Bow Saint over the hall; the source places her in the blood-covered hall and says she revealed her identity.
findings.rationale: 대연회장 위 refers to the scene in the hall, while 정체를 드러낸 specifies the revelation of her identity.
findings.replacement: In the imperial palace’s grand banquet hall, covered in the rebels’ blood and corpses, the Bow Saint finally revealed her identity and spoke.
findings.source: 반란군의 피와 시체로 뒤덮인 황궁의 대연회장 위, 마침내 정체를 드러낸 궁성(弓星)이 말을 이었다.

findings.current: The reputations of their extraordinary mages and knights had shaken the entire continent, crossing the seas.
findings.defect: Singular “continent” reduces the reach of their reputations from all continents to one.
findings.rationale: 전 대륙 means all continents; the source has already established that Morgoth’s world has twelve.
findings.replacement: The fame of their extraordinary mages and knights had crossed the seas and shaken every continent.
findings.source: 뛰어난 마법사와 기사들의 명성은 바다를 넘어 전 대륙을 뒤흔들었다.

findings.current: gain more money and fame—to become a son and older brother he could be proud of.
findings.defect: The draft makes Taekyung proud of himself rather than someone his family can be proud of.
findings.rationale: 자랑스러운 아들이자 오빠 describes the son and older brother he wanted to be for his family.
findings.replacement: gain more money and fame—and become a son and older brother his family could be proud of.
findings.source: 이를 말미암아 더욱 많은 돈과 유명세를 얻어 자랑스러운 아들이자 오빠가 되고 싶었다.

findings.current: He had seen a being who defied the laws of nature, and confirmed that a human chosen by God existed.
findings.defect: “Laws of nature” replaces the ordained order or providence invoked by 섭리, weakening the passage’s divine framing.
findings.rationale: 정해진 섭리 concerns a predetermined order, not specifically natural law.
findings.replacement: He had seen a being who stood outside the ordained order, and confirmed the existence of a human chosen by God.
findings.source: 정해진 섭리를 벗어난 존재를 보았고, 신의 선택을 받은 인간 또한 확인했으니.

findings.current: Along with it came the weight of an enormous responsibility he couldn’t have imagined, couldn’t even have imagined, just two years ago.
findings.defect: The repeated English phrase loses the distinction between never having imagined it and being unable to imagine it.
findings.rationale: 상상한 적도, 할 수도 없었던 expresses both that he had not imagined it and that he could not have.
findings.replacement: And with it came the weight of an enormous responsibility he had never imagined—and could never have imagined—just two years earlier.
findings.source: 불과 이 년 전에는 상상한 적도, 할 수도 없었던 막대한 책임감의 무게도 함께.

findings.current: He had achieved it, and he was still moving forward.
findings.defect: The draft changes ongoing growth into Taekyung moving forward.
findings.rationale: Both verbs refer back to 성장, which has happened and continues.
findings.replacement: He had grown, and he was still growing.

findings.current: The power and shining life contained in those two words, spoken through parched lips.
findings.defect: “Hope” is one English word, not two.
findings.rationale: 두 글자 counts the two Korean syllable blocks in 희망; that count does not carry over to English.
findings.replacement: The power and bright vitality in the word that had passed through those parched lips.
findings.source: 바짝 메마른 입술 사이로 흘러나온 두 글자에 담긴 힘을, 반짝이는 생기를.

summary: Actionable errors in location, geographic quantity, family motivation, the account of growth, and divine terminology.
